title: Bahubali: The Beginning
desc: A tribal-raised boy learns he is Mahishmati royalty, discovers his father's bravery, and aims to overthrow the current king.

title: Bhakta Prahlada
desc: Prince Prahlada, the pious son of an asura king, must endure his father's wrath due to his unmoving devotion towards Lord Vishnu.

title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.

title: Ee Bandhana
desc: An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.
